sentences.text: For the reasons mentioned in the application, I.A. No.23842 of 2024 is hereby allowed and disposed of.
I.A No.28704 of 2023 is an application under Section 389 (1) of the Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the Dalchan @ Dalu.

This appeal is filed by the appellant being aggrieved of the judgment dated 23.11.2023 passed in Special Case No.07 of 2020 by learned Special Judge, Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 Khandwa, District-Khandwa (M.P.) whereby the appellant has been convicted for offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n)/109 and 376(3)/109 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 16/17 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and sentenced to undergo RI for 25 years with fine of Rs.5,000/- in default of payment of fine to further undergo RI for two years and .

entities.text: Special Judge, Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 Khandwa
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that appellant has been falsely implicated.
There is no allegation of any overt act either at the time of 2 CRA-15239-2023 kidnapping of the prosecutrix or at the time of commission of rape.
Prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure had made allegation against the present appellant along with the co-accused of violating her privacy.

Later on, in the Court's statement, the prosecutrix has changed her version to say that only Shantilal had violated her privacy and the present appellant along with another juvenile were standing as a night watchmen.
It is further submitted that the D.N.A. report Exhibit-C/1 matches qua Shantilal only and there is no matching qua present appellant.
Appellant and juvenile have been acquitted from the charges of commission of rape.

They have been implicated with the aid of Section 16/17 of the Protection of Dalchand @ Dalu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199232802/
1 Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 for abetment of an offence.

entities.text: Protection of Dalchand @ Dalu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The theory of appellant standing in the night of 23.12.2019 to watch the incident being performed by Shantilal does not inspire confidence.

It is pointed out that the prosecutrix in her Court's statement was examined as P.W-2, she has narrated that after Shantilal even the present appellant and the juvenile had committed rape but this fact was not narrated by her to Dr. Shailja (P.W-12) as is evident from Exhibit-P/31, therefore,
the statement of the prosecutrix in regard to presence of the present appellant with the juvenile does not inspire confidence.
The appellant has no criminal antecedents.

It is submitted that disposal of the present appeal will take a considerable time and, therefore, it is prayed that remaining part of sentence imposed on the present appellant be suspended and they be granted bail.
Learned Government Advocate has vehemently opposed the prayer for 3 CRA-15239-2023 suspension of sentence.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case to suspend the remaining part of the jail sentence of the present appellant and to release him on bail.
Accordingly, I.A.No.28704 of 2023 is allowed.

It is directed that on depositing of fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on 20.12.2024 and on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the concerned Court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of appellant shall remain suspended and he be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
List for final hearing in due course.
Certified copy as per rules.
